missing_evidence: Allocation origins do not say whether a retained evaluation cell holds a numeric approximation, a quadratic tower, only a fixed-domain decline flag, or combinations. Need occupancy and post-drop conservation before proposing representation changes.
domain: Same original Nano profile/release pipeline and exact scalar behavior; private diagnostic build only.
implementation: Eight atomic counters indexed by presence bits approximation=1,tower=2,declined=4. Count each allocated cell before publication; transfer state under its existing write lock; decrement unpublished losers and final owned drops. No new per-node field, pointer, key, eviction or algorithm branch. A private associated function publishes numeric counts only to the diagnostic benchmark.
acceptance: Independent direct cache exercise visits all eight occupancy states, checks exact counter deltas, verifies drop returns to starting census, and records actual cell layout bytes. Compare stage completion/DRC/projection controls to the frozen allocation-only diagnostic.
scope: Instrumentation can change allocation-free CPU work and native timing is not comparable. Empty transient candidates count during publication; stage snapshots are taken after synchronous operations finish. These counts do not bound coefficient payloads or establish semantic ownership of shared rationals.
retention: Only private source/targets change. Keep earlier frozen binary, captures, scripts and failed analysis attempts. No cache policy is proposed or admitted.
